@isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingTemplateCapacityEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { EmailTemplate tmpl = new EmailTemplate(Name = 'Trail Template', DeveloperName = 'Trail_Template', FolderId = '00l000000000001AAA', Subject = 'Trail subject', Body = 'Trail body', HtmlValue = '

Trail body

'); insert tmpl; List rendered = Messaging.renderEmailTemplate('003000000000001AAA', '001000000000001AAA', new List{'Hello trail', 'Account trail'}); System.assertEquals(2, rendered.size()); System.assert(rendered.get(0).getSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Hello trail', rendered.get(0).getMergedBody()); System.assertEquals(0, rendered.get(0).getErrors().size()); System.assertEquals('Account trail', rendered.get(1).getMergedBody()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage stored = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(tmpl.Id, '003000000000001AAA', '001000000000001AAA'); System.assertEquals('Trail subject', stored.getSubject()); System.assertEquals('Trail body', stored.getPlainTextBody()); Messaging.reserveSingleEmailCapacity(1); Messaging.reserveMassEmailCapacity(1); List results = Messaging.sendEmailMessage(new List{'02s000000000001AAA'}, false); System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); System.assert(results.get(0).isSuccess()); List defaulted = Messaging.sendEmailMessage(new List{'02s000000000002AAA'}); System.assertEquals(1, defaulted.size()); System.assert(defaulted.get(0).isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(2, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); Messaging.InboundEmail inbound = Messaging.extractInboundEmail('raw message not parsed locally', true); System.assertEquals(0, inbound.headers.size()); System.assertEquals(false, inbound.plainTextBodyIsTruncated); } }
